item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 09/May/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will bring slightly cooler weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. With the easterly airstream moderating gradually, the weather will improve over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. Meanwhile, under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, it will be hot during the day over the region. A southwesterly airstream will bring unsettled weather to the coastal areas in the latter part of next week. There will be occasional showers and squally thunderstorms over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Hagupit now over the western North Pacific is expected to move in the general direction of the seas east of the Philippines in the next few days.
